current_date: Adopted October 2025 (Version 4, reviewed 4 January 2025, published October 2025; applies to applications submitted on or after 1 October 2025)
current_evidence: The Validation Local List page has the heading 'Validation Local List (Adopted October 2025)' and links '...October-2025-1-1.pdf'. That file and the workbook's '...October-2025.pdf' both contain the same Version 4 text (129,361 characters each), and neither the page nor the 2025 consultation page mentions a later version.

issues.detail: The workbook URL is not the file the council's Validation Local List page links. The page links '...October-2025-1-1.pdf'; the workbook uses '...October-2025.pdf' on the same 'blobwealdengov-staging' CDN. The content is identical (Version 4), but the page's link is the canonical one and is less likely to break.
issues.evidence: Validation Local List page: 'View the Validation Local List' -> Wealden-District-Council-Validation-Requirements-October-2025-1-1.pdf

issues.detail: Date basis is 'url'. The date is correct, but it should come from the text: Version 4 was published October 2025 and applies to applications submitted on or after 1 October 2025.
issues.evidence: 'Version 4: Reviewed 4 January 2025, published October 2025'; consultation page: 'on or after 1 October 2025'

issues.detail: Many items come from the superseded February 2023 (Version 3) list: all six 'Drawing / document standards' items, most 'Submission rules' items, all 'Policy-driven requirements' items, the Full planning Design and Access Statement row, the LBC Photographs row and the Pre-application row. Version 4 (October 2025) replaced it and removed the application-type checklists.

'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' is listed as a Full planning requirement, but the local list says this requirement was removed. Its trigger is change-log text, and it gets the date wrong: the list says it was removed in Version 3 (Feb 2023).
issues.evidence: Version history: 'Version 3: Reviewed 3 January 2023 ... Local Requirement for a Biodiversity Checklist removed'; Grokbot trigger: 'Local Requirement for Biodiversity Checklist removed 4 January 2025'

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only', but the local list applies to householder applications. Examples are Bat Survey (householder triggers by building age and 200m/400m distance to woodland/water), Flood Risk Assessment, Daylight/Sunlight, CIL forms for extensions, and Parking & Access details where parking at individual dwellings changes.
issues.evidence: Parking & Access: 'any development altering existing parking or access arrangements, including at individual dwellings'; Bat Survey householder triggers in the local list

issues.detail: Section 1.4 excludes only NMA, approval of conditions, adverts, LDCs, prior approvals and TPO tree works. Every other type (Outline, Reserved matters, LBC, s73, Demolition in conservation area, PiP) is subject to the local list. Grokbot put about 50 requirements under Full planning marked 'INFERRED ... placed under Full planning' and recorded Outline and Reserved matters as '(none)'. Examples: Affordable Housing, Flood Risk Assessment and Energy Statement also apply to Outline. Structural Survey explicitly covers demolition in a Conservation Area and listed building works.
issues.evidence: Section 1.4: 'The Local Validation List DOES NOT apply to the following types of application: Non-material amendments, Approval under conditions, Advertisement consents, Lawful Development Certificates, Prior Approval Notifications, Consent for works to a tree with TPO'

issues.detail: Several local requirements in Version 4 have no row. (1) Aerodrome Safeguarding Statement: wind turbines within 30km of an aerodrome, structures above safeguarding thresholds, bird-hazard and lighting risks. (2) Bat Survey as its own requirement, with householder age and distance triggers (it appears only as a fragment in the Ecological row). (3) Equestrian Management Plan: equine or commercial horse use, manèges and their lighting, horse shelters. (4) Historic Environment Record (HER) Report, for Archaeological Notification Areas where East Sussex HER confirms it is needed. (5) Road Safety Audit Stage 1, for major development with a new or intensified access, off-site highway works or new estate roads. (6) Refuse Vehicle Tracking Plan, for new development and development affecting roads (12m / 26t vehicle, no reversing over 25m). (7) Playing Field / Sports Provision Assessment, for development on or affecting a playing field or creating a sports facility.
issues.evidence: Version 4 local list entries: 'Aerodrome Safeguarding Statement', 'Equestrian Management Plan', 'Historic Environment Record (HER) Report', 'Road Safety Audit (Stage 1 at validation)', 'Refuse Vehicle Tracking Plan', 'Playing Field / Sports Provision Assessment'

issues.detail: The Surface Water Drainage Strategy is not captured with its trigger. It applies to all sites and to every application that creates or changes foul or surface water systems, including extensions and increased hardstanding. Sites in the Pevensey Levels catchment must control runoff quality and volume and attenuate to 1 in 100 years + 40% + urban creep. Grokbot's 'Drainage Strategy / SuDS' row instead has flood-risk sequential/exception test header text. Two other items are missing or wrongly mapped. The 'Emissions Mitigation Assessment' (part of the AQA) is absent. 'Agricultural Statement and/or Form PA4/PA7' is mapped only to a functional-need fragment.
issues.evidence: Surface Water Drainage Strategy: 'In the Pevensey Levels catchment, control runoff quality and volume... 1 in 100-year event plus 40%'

issues.detail: Several triggers leave out the thresholds the list sets. Affordable Housing has the NPPF definition instead of '10 or more net dwellings; 5 or more within an AONB; or sites of 0.5ha+'. Statement of Community Involvement lacks '200+ dwellings or 4ha+; non-residential >10,000 sq m or 2ha+'. Retail Assessment lacks the 2,500 sq m threshold. Energy Statement stops at 'consist of the following:' and never lists the development types.
issues.evidence: Grokbot Affordable Housing trigger: 'NOTE: The NPPF defines affordable housing as "housing for sale or rent..."'

issues.detail: About a dozen triggers are only column headers or policy references ('Justification including policy driver ... NPPF: Section X'), with no trigger. This affects Arboricultural/Tree Survey, Land Contamination, Ground Stability, Heritage Statement, Noise, Open Space, Transport Assessment, Telecoms, Economic Statement, Landscaping, Marketing and Viability. Others are mis-mapped. The LVIA row has the Transport Assessment heading. Travel Plan and the Policy-driven 'Ashdown Forest' item are a garbled Planning Obligations trigger list ('...within 7km of the Ashdown Forest Development which generates the requirement for a Travel Plan ... CIL Regulations 2010'). Ventilation/Extraction has an AQA fragment. HRA reads 'to inform a Habitats Regulations Assessment.' Waste/refuse reads 'arising and refuse collection/'.
issues.evidence: Contamination trigger: 'is required Land Contamination Assessment NPPF: Section 15 (Conserving and enhancing the natural environment).'

issues.detail: Two rows are mislabelled. 'Coal Mining / Land Stability Risk Assessment' is Wealden's 'Ground Stability Assessment', which applies to significant level changes near properties or known or suspected instability, not coal mining. 'Agricultural Land Classification / Soils' is the 'Soils Management Plan', which applies to topsoil/subsoil movement and engineering operations.
issues.evidence: Local list: 'Ground Stability Assessment', 'Soils Management Plan'

issues.detail: Several items are not validation requirements. The Submission rules are mostly GDPR and redaction text, covering-letter advice, the 10MB file limit and hand-signed certificates. The County Archaeologist pre-app contact paragraph is boilerplate. Photographs / Photomontages is 'not a policy requirement' but is listed as one under Full planning and LBC. Pre-application advice is advisory. Two Policy-driven items ('Special Protection Areas (SPA) including potential SPAs;' and 'The Ashdown Forest SPA and SAC is a European designated nature conservation site.') are descriptive fragments.
issues.evidence: Photographs trigger: 'Although not a policy requirement, photographs can provide clarity'

issues.detail: The County Archaeologist pre-application paragraph appears twice in Submission rules, once from the 2023 list and once from the 2025 list. LVIA and Transport Assessment share the same Transport Assessment trigger text.

summary: The workbook's October 2025 (Version 4) list is the current adopted list, though the council page links an identical '-1-1' copy of the file. Grokbot's extraction mixes in the superseded 2023 list and lists the removed Biodiversity Checklist as a requirement. It marks Householder, Outline and Reserved matters as having no local requirements, misses several local items (Aerodrome Safeguarding, Equestrian, HER report, Road Safety Audit, Refuse tracking, Playing fields, Surface Water Drainage) and leaves out key thresholds such as the affordable housing ones.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
